# konnect_identity_principal_identity (Resource)

IdentityPrincipalIdentity Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_principal_identity" "my_identityprincipalidentity" {
  auth_server_client = {
    auth_server_id = "764ebd98-5bf8-4c1c-862c-0c115cc3fd21"
    client_id      = "...my_client_id..."
    labels = {
      key = "value"
    }
    managed_by = {
      key = "value"
    }
  }
  control_plane_consumer = {
    consumer_id      = "...my_consumer_id..."
    control_plane_id = "...my_control_plane_id..."
    labels = {
      key = "value"
    }
    managed_by = {
      key = "value"
    }
    workspace_id = "...my_workspace_id..."
  }
  custom = {
    key = "...my_key..."
    labels = {
      key = "value"
    }
    managed_by = {
      key = "value"
    }
    value = "...my_value..."
  }
  directory_id = "b6e820c3-0070-4ea2-ad6f-3b44c07d409d"
  oidc = {
    claim = {
      name  = "...my_name..."
      value = "...my_value..."
    }
    issuer = "...my_issuer..."
    labels = {
      key = "value"
    }
    managed_by = {
      key = "value"
    }
  }
  principal_id = "b63e8652-e7d8-41ba-ba07-d093efe7352c"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_principal_identity.my_konnect_identity_principal_identity
  id = jsonencode({
    directory_id = "..."
    id           = "..."
    principal_id = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_principal_identity.my_konnect_identity_principal_identity '{"directory_id": "...", "id": "...", "principal_id": "..."}'
```
